frames.title: Origins Classroom: How to set ROAS targets for scaling
frames.on_screen:
Course module page: 'How to set ROAS targets for scaling'
Link To Calculator: https://www.easyamedia.com/profit-calculator
REMINDER
That calculator can be glitchy. So if you're having issues, make sure you just remove the numbers and type them back in. And if you have any empty spaces, make sure you put a zero.
If you message me saying the calculator is broken, I will tell you to come back [and watch] the video again.
tldr;
Take your breakeven ROAS and add "1" to it.
Example:
B/E ROAS = 1.6 -> Target ROAS = 2.6

frames.title: Origins Classroom: How to determine minimum daily spend
frames.on_screen:
Module title: 'How to determine minimum daily spend'
Text:
'If you're spending above $500 per day, you can ignore this'
'If you are not, the minimum daily spend is WHATEVER you're comfortable spending per day, no matter WHAT.'
'Ideally, we recommend a minimum of $50-$100 per day'
'You can be less, you can be more, but $100 per day is always a great place to start [for] the machine data.'
'Just make sure you have the budget to test for 1-2+ months.'
frames.not_in_transcript: Rule: 'If you're spending above $500 per day, you can ignore this'; budget requirement note: 'Just make sure you have the budget to test for 1-2+ months.'

frames.title: Origins Classroom: How to setup your 3:2:2 campaign
frames.on_screen:
Module title: 'How to setup your 3:2:2 campaign'
'To Sum Up:
1 Campaign
1 Champions Ad set, Multiple Creative Test Ad Sets
3 creatives in each ad set (same concept), each with 2 headlines and 2 copies'
'WARNING DO NOT TURN OFF YOUR EXISTING ADS IF THEY ARE WORKING. THE DUMBEST THING YOU CAN DO IS TURN OFF ADS THAT ARE WORKING. IF YOU[R] CAMPAIGNS ARE WORKING - LEAVE THEM ON - IF YOU TURN THEM OFF AND [LOSE MONEY]... THAT IS ON YOU.'
'FAQ:
1. How many creative ad sets can you launch at a time?
- If you're only spending few hundred a day, I recommend keeping it to 5 [...] (including champions ad set, if it has ads inside) at a time so budget ca[n be] distributed efficiently. Focus more on intent of the ads instead of throw[ing against] the wall.'
frames.not_in_transcript: Setup structure breakdown: '1 Champions Ad set, Multiple Creative Test Ad Sets', '3 creatives in each ad set (same concept), each with 2 headlines and 2 copies'; warning text verbatim; FAQ detail recommending max 5 ad sets at a time.
